custom_assistant_wake_word_deleted: "%s" was deleted. A device that already downloaded it keeps its copy.
custom_assistant_wake_word_hint: The wake word runs on the device. Hover a word to see which languages it was trained on — most are English only.
custom_assistant_wake_word_phrase_hint: What you say to wake the device — this is how it appears in the list.
custom_assistant_wake_word_upload_hint: A microWakeWord model: the .tflite file, ideally together with its .json. Other model types (openWakeWord, Porcupine) cannot be installed this way.
custom_assistant_wake_word_uploaded: "%s" was uploaded. Select it above to activate it — the device downloads the model then.
custom_assistant_bundled_wake_word_hint: Click: load onto the device and switch on — replaces an older version of the same word
custom_assistant_wake_word_installed: "%s" is switched on — the device is downloading the model.
custom_assistant_wake_word_installed_rep: "%s" is switched on instead of "%s" — the device is downloading the model.
custom_assistant_wake_word_installed_ful: "%s" is now in the list, but every slot is taken. Switch another wake word off, then select "%s".
custom_assistant_Asks the loaded model t: Asks the loaded model test questions in the language of the assistant and in English: home questions must be handed over, general ones answered correctly
custom_assistant_Estimate from the model: Estimate from the model size, not measured. Use the benchmark for real numbers.

custom_assistant_Satellites of the adapt: Satellites of the adapter assistant-satellite always work. Details on the tabs Voice and Satellites.

custom_assistant_The tab Chat of these s: The tab Chat of these settings, also to try out every step.
custom_assistant_From a script: %s, or w: From a script: %s, or write the question into %s.
custom_assistant_Every request goes to t: Every request goes to the models. Only the routines are still checked first.
custom_assistant_Fixed rules understand: Fixed rules understand switching, dimming and status of devices, timers, alarms, the time and the weather — in a few milliseconds, offline. What they do not understand goes on.
custom_assistant_The adapter smart-text2: The adapter smart-text2command learns your phrasing from examples, runs only the actions you approved there and asks back when the room or the device is unclear. It understands German and English. Timers, alarms, the time and the weather stay with the built-in rules; what neither understands goes on.
custom_assistant_Before this, %s routine: Before this, %s routines are checked (tab Commands).
custom_assistant_Routines (fixed phrases: Routines (fixed phrases with their own actions) are set up on the tab Commands.
custom_assistant_The list of models need: The list of models needs the running instance.
custom_assistant_Without a cloud step th: Without a cloud step the local model is the last step.
custom_assistant_Every request the local: Every request the local decision does not understand goes to it first. Saves cloud calls, but on a Raspberry Pi it adds 10–25 seconds.
custom_assistant_It only answers when th: It only answers when the cloud fails (offline, quota).
custom_assistant_Download and compare mo: Download and compare models on the tab Local models.
custom_assistant_Only the local steps an: Only the local steps answer; a request they do not understand gets a fixed sentence.
custom_assistant_Provider, model and key: Provider, model and key come from the system settings of admin (tab AI there).
custom_assistant_The API key and the oth: The API key and the other details are on the tab AI.
custom_assistant_The adapter pi-agent an: The adapter pi-agent answers with its own model, tools and write permissions; every request source gets a conversation of its own there.
custom_assistant_Changes take effect whe: Changes take effect when the settings are saved.
custom_assistant_How a request goes thro: How a request goes through the assistant. Every step answers what it understands, the rest goes on to the next one. Click a step to set it up.
custom_assistant_Before every step: a st: Before every step: a stop word silences a ringing timer, the answer to an open question goes to whoever asked, and "dialog mode on/off" switches the dialog of a satellite. A request about a script or with a picture goes straight to the cloud step.
custom_assistant_%s s on average (%s in: %s s on average (%s in the journal)
custom_assistant_Only answers to speech;: Only answers to speech; text requests get text back.
custom_assistant_Turns the speech of the: Turns the speech of the satellites into text. It also hears voice messages from Telegram and the dialog mode of the chat. Keys and more options are on the tab Voice.
custom_assistant_Speaks the answer on th: Speaks the answer on the satellite that asked, and the announcements. Keys and more options are on the tab Voice.
custom_assistant_Follow-up questions in: Follow-up questions in a conversation go straight to the cloud.
custom_assistant_What no step understand: What no step understands gets a fixed sentence.
